levels.name: Stage: Non-rejectable model
levels.meaning: EFC cannot be rejected on current data and shows consistent Δχ² ≤ 0 across independent probes. This is NOT a claim of correctness, only that the model survives current falsification attempts.

levels.name: Consistent with data (robust)
levels.meaning: Probe yields Δχ² ≤ 0 or decisive ΔAIC in EFC direction, reproduced across independent runs or datasets. Does NOT mean 'EFC is correct' — only that the data does not reject it.

levels.name: Consistent with data (preliminary / limited sample)
levels.meaning: Probe yields Δχ² ≤ 0 but sample is small, result is not decisive, or test is not independent of calibration. Consistency is real but under-powered.

levels.name: Completed (Data Likelihood Test)
levels.meaning: Full quantitative comparison using established statistical frameworks with real data

levels.name: Completed (Consistency Check)
levels.meaning: EFC predicts minimal deviation; observations show no contradiction

levels.name: Completed (Structural Constraint)
levels.meaning: Geometric arguments rule out operator classes without parameter fitting

levels.name: Phenomenological
levels.meaning: Temporary parameterization tested empirically but not derived from field theory

levels.name: Framework-Level Diagnostic
levels.meaning: Internal coherence evaluation rather than direct observable comparison

levels.name: Conceptual / Method Defined
levels.meaning: Observable link identified; derivation still needed

levels.name: Discrepant
levels.meaning: Predictions conflict with observations beyond statistical tolerance
